description: This file defines API endpoints for a mobile service website backend using Flask and Flask-Smorest. It includes routes for services, brands, models, booking, admin functions, and static content like about and contact information, with authentication and authorization logic.

classes.name: Services
classes.description: API endpoint for listing available services.

classes.name: Brands
classes.description: API endpoint for listing device brands.

classes.name: Models
classes.description: API endpoint for listing device models filtered by brand.

classes.name: BookingServices
classes.description: API endpoint for listing repair services.

classes.name: About
classes.description: API endpoint for static about content.

classes.name: SubmitForm
classes.description: API endpoint for submitting customer requests.

classes.name: BookingUpdate
classes.description: API endpoint for updating booking details.

classes.name: AdminBookings
classes.description: Admin API endpoint for listing recent bookings.
